add_blackboard_key.doc: X.add_blackboard_key(blackboard_path, key_name, key_type="object", base_class_path="", enum_path="") -> bool

add_anim_conduit.description:
Add a conduit (branching helper state) inside a state-machine graph.
Its BoundGraph is a bool rule graph rather than an anim graph.
add_anim_conduit.doc: X.add_anim_conduit(anim_blueprint_path, state_machine_graph_name, conduit_name, pos_x, pos_y) -> str

add_anim_graph_node_blend_list_by_int.description: Spawn a UAnimGraphNode_BlendListByInt with the requested number of poses (min 2).

add_anim_graph_node_blend_space_player.description:
Spawn a UAnimGraphNode_BlendSpacePlayer in `GraphName`, bound to BlendSpacePath.
Accepts both 1D and 2D blend spaces.

add_anim_graph_node_by_class_name.description:
Generic AnimGraph node factory by short class name (e.g. "AnimGraphNode_ApplyAdditive",
"AnimGraphNode_ModifyBone", "AnimGraphNode_ObserveBone", "AnimGraphNode_SaveCachedPose",
"AnimGraphNode_UseCachedPose", "AnimGraphNode_Root", "AnimGraphNode_ConvertComponentToLocalSpace"
etc). Fallback when the typed helpers don't cover the desired node.
Returns the new node's GUID, or "" on failure (class not found / not a UAnimGraphNode_Base subclass).

add_anim_graph_node_layered_bone_blend.description: Spawn a UAnimGraphNode_LayeredBoneBlend with the requested number of extra blend poses (min 1).

add_anim_graph_node_linked_anim_layer.description:
Spawn a UAnimGraphNode_LinkedAnimLayer bound to (InterfaceClassPath, LayerName).
Call ReconstructNode() so the linked layer's custom pins appear.
InterfaceClassPath may be empty for a layer on the same ABP.
add_anim_graph_node_linked_anim_layer.doc: X.add_anim_graph_node_linked_anim_layer(anim_blueprint_path, graph_name, interface_class_path, layer_name, pos_x, pos_y) -> str

add_anim_graph_node_sequence_player.description:
Spawn a UAnimGraphNode_SequencePlayer in `GraphName`, bound to SequencePath.
GraphName may be the top-level "AnimGraph" or any state's BoundGraph name
(from ListAnimGraphs). Returns the new node's GUID (empty on failure).

SequencePath may be empty — the node is created with no anim asset.
Does NOT auto-compile; call compile_blueprint after a batch.

add_anim_graph_node_slot.description:
Spawn a UAnimGraphNode_Slot with the given slot name.
The slot will be registered on the target skeleton if it isn't already.

add_anim_graph_node_state_machine.description:
Spawn a UAnimGraphNode_StateMachine and auto-create its interior
UAnimationStateMachineGraph (renamed to StateMachineName; uniquified if
taken). The interior graph's name is what later write ops use to
target states/transitions inside it. Returns the outer node's GUID.

add_anim_graph_node_two_way_blend.description: Spawn a UAnimGraphNode_TwoWayBlend (FAnimNode_TwoWayBlend — field is `BlendNode`, not `Node`).

add_anim_notify.description:
Add a name-only anim notify to an AnimSequence at TriggerTime.
Duration > 0 creates a state notify (without a class); 0 creates an instant notify.
Returns true on success; marks the package dirty on success.

add_anim_state.description:
Add a new state inside the given state-machine graph. The state's
BoundGraph (a UAnimationStateGraph containing a StateResult node) is
auto-created and renamed to StateName (uniquified if taken).
Returns the new AnimStateNode's GUID.
add_anim_state.doc: X.add_anim_state(anim_blueprint_path, state_machine_graph_name, state_name, pos_x, pos_y) -> str

add_anim_sync_marker.description:
Append a sync marker to an AnimSequence's AuthoredSyncMarkers.
Rejects empty name and out-of-range time; duplicates (same name+time) are allowed (matches editor behaviour).
Marks the package dirty on success; markers are re-sorted by time.

add_anim_transition.description:
Create a transition edge From -> To (states or conduits by name) inside
a state-machine graph. The transition's rule graph is auto-created.
Returns the transition node's GUID.

add_montage_section.description: Add a composite section to a montage. Returns false when name already exists or StartTime invalid.

add_skeleton_socket.doc: X.add_skeleton_socket(skeleton_path, socket_name, parent_bone_name, relative_location, relative_rotation, relative_scale) -> bool

auto_layout_anim_graph.description:
Auto-layout an AnimGraph (pose-link flow). Nodes are layered L→R by the
pose-link DAG: sinks (AnimGraphNode_Root / StateResult / TransitionResult)
on the right, leaf sources on the left. Within each layer, nodes are
sorted by barycentric order of their successors. Mirrors the BP
Sugiyama-lite layout but tuned for anim graphs.

@param HorizontalSpacing  Gap between layers. 0 or negative = default (100).
@param VerticalSpacing    Gap between nodes within a layer. 0 or negative = default (60).

auto_layout_state_machine.description:
Auto-layout the *interior* of a state-machine graph. States are arranged
in a 2-D grid (roughly square). Conduits interleave with states. The
entry node is pinned at the top-left. Transitions follow along.

Additionally runs AutoLayoutAnimGraph on every state's BoundGraph + every
transition's rule graph, so one call tidies the whole state machine.

@param HorizontalSpacing  Gap between state columns. 0 or negative = default (300).
@param VerticalSpacing    Gap between state rows. 0 or negative = default (200).

connect_anim_graph_pins.description:
Connect two pins inside an AnimGraph-family graph (includes pose-link pins,
state-transition "In"/"Out" pins, and any K2 pin inside a transition rule
or state's anim graph). Uses the owning graph's schema — the anim schema
handles local↔component pose conversion automatically.
Returns true when the link was created.
connect_anim_graph_pins.doc: X.connect_anim_graph_pins(anim_blueprint_path, graph_name, source_node_guid, source_pin_name, target_node_guid, target_pin_name) -> bool

disconnect_anim_graph_pin.description: Break every link on a single named pin of a node. Returns true on success.

find_anim_graph_node_by_class.description:
Convenience: return the GUID of the first node of class `ShortClassName`
(e.g. "AnimGraphNode_Root", "AnimGraphNode_StateResult",
"AnimGraphNode_TransitionResult", "AnimStateEntryNode") inside GraphName.
Empty string if no match or graph not found.

get_anim_blueprint_info.description: Get high-level AnimBlueprint metadata: parent class, target skeleton, preview mesh, graph counts, interfaces.

get_anim_curves.description: Get curves referenced in the AnimGraph.

get_anim_graph_info.description: Get all state machines in an Animation Blueprint.

get_anim_graph_nodes.description: Get all nodes in the AnimGraph with connections.

get_anim_node_details.description: Get non-default properties of a specific anim graph node by its NodeIndex (as returned by GetAnimGraphNodes). LIMITED to the top-level AnimGraph; for state interiors / transition rules / nested function graphs use GetAnimNodeDetailsByGuid.

get_anim_sequence_info.description: Get animation sequence info: length, notifies, curves.

get_anim_slots.description: Get all Slot nodes with their slot names.

get_anim_sync_markers.description: Get authored sync markers on an AnimSequence (sorted by time).

get_anim_transition_rule_graph_name.description:
Get the name of the transition rule graph for the From -> To edge.
Empty string if the transition doesn't exist.

Use this as the `graph_name` argument to the Blueprint library when
authoring K2 logic inside the rule (variable reads, comparisons,
boolean ops, etc.). `AddAnimTransition` names rule graphs uniquely
as `Rule_<From>_to_<To>` so this accessor returns a stable handle.

get_blend_profile_entries.description: Get the per-bone entries of a specific blend profile on a skeleton.

get_blend_space_info.description: Get blend space info: axes, samples.

get_montage_info.description: Get montage info: sections, slot, blend settings, notifies.

get_montage_slot_segments.description: Get the anim segments laid out on each montage slot track (order = layout in the slot).

get_skeleton_blend_profiles.description: Get all blend profiles defined on a skeleton (name, mode, entry count).

get_skeleton_sockets.description: Get all sockets defined on a skeleton (attach points for weapons, FX, etc.).

get_skeleton_virtual_bones.description: Get all virtual bones defined on a skeleton (synthetic bones mapping source->target for animation constraints).

list_anim_graph_nodes.description:
List (node_guid, node_class_short_name, node_title) for every node in
the named graph. Unlike UnrealBridgeBlueprintLibrary.get_function_nodes
(which only walks top-level FunctionGraphs), this uses the same
recursive graph resolver as every other anim write op — so it works on
state machine interiors, state BoundGraphs, and transition rule graphs.

Returned rows: `"<guid>\t<class>\t<title>"` — lightweight tab-separated
to avoid introducing yet another USTRUCT for a basic listing.

list_anim_graphs.description:
Enumerate every UEdGraph inside the AnimBlueprint and classify it:
top-level "AnimGraph", a state-machine graph, a state's BoundGraph,
a conduit, a transition rule graph, a regular K2 function, etc.

Use the `Name` field of the returned entries as the `GraphName` parameter
to every other write op. ParentGraphName locates where each sub-graph
lives (e.g. a state's BoundGraph lists its owning state-machine graph
as parent, so you can reconstruct the hierarchy client-side).

remove_anim_graph_node.description: Remove a node from an AnimGraph-family graph by GUID. Returns true if a node was removed.

remove_anim_notifies_by_name.description: Remove all notifies whose NotifyName matches (case-insensitive). Returns removed count.

remove_anim_state.description: Remove a named state (or conduit) from a state-machine graph. Cleans up attached transitions.

remove_anim_sync_markers_by_name.description: Remove every authored sync marker whose name matches (exact FName compare). Returns removed count.

remove_anim_transition.description: Remove the transition From -> To (or first match, when multiple exist).

remove_montage_section.description: Remove a composite section from a montage by name. Returns true when removed; also clears any `NextSectionName` references to it.

remove_skeleton_socket.description: Remove a named socket from a skeleton. Returns true when a socket was removed.

rename_anim_state.description: Rename a state by renaming its BoundGraph (which is the authoritative state name).

rename_skeleton_socket.description:
Rename an existing socket on a skeleton. Fails when the old socket is missing or the new name is empty / already used.
Marks the skeleton package dirty on success.

set_anim_graph_node_position.description: Set the (NodePosX, NodePosY) of a node in an AnimGraph-family graph.

set_anim_sequence_player_sequence.description: Change a SequencePlayer's bound sequence. Empty path clears the binding.

set_anim_slot_name.description: Change a Slot node's slot name.

set_anim_state_default.description:
Set the default entry state: links StateMachineGraph->EntryNode's output
pin to StateName's input pin, clearing any prior default link.

set_anim_transition_const_rule.description:
Set a transition rule to a constant boolean. Replaces the rule-graph
result node's bool input with a literal value — convenient when you
just need "always transition" or "never" without authoring nodes.
For anything more complex, query the transition's rule-graph name via
ListAnimGraphs and use the BP library to author nodes inside it.

set_anim_transition_properties.description:
Tune a transition's blend properties.
`CrossfadeDuration` negative = leave unchanged.
`PriorityOrder` INT_MIN (i.e. -2147483648) = leave unchanged.
`bBidirectional` is always written.
set_anim_transition_properties.doc: X.set_anim_transition_properties(anim_blueprint_path, state_machine_graph_name, from_state_name, to_state_name, crossfade_duration, priority_order, bidirectional) -> bool

set_montage_blend_times.doc: X.set_montage_blend_times(montage_path, blend_in_time, blend_out_time, blend_out_trigger_time, enable_auto_blend_out) -> bool

set_montage_section_next.description: Wire SectionName -> NextSectionName on a montage; pass empty NextSectionName to clear the link.

set_montage_section_start_time.description: Move an existing montage composite section to a new start time. Sections are re-sorted on success.

set_skeleton_socket_transform.description:
Set the transform of an existing socket on a skeleton. Returns false when the socket is missing.
Marks the skeleton package dirty on success.

create_blueprint.description:
Create a Blueprint derived from ParentClassPath. Existing assets are returned unchanged.
The new package is marked dirty but is only saved when bSave is true.

does_asset_exist.description: Does the AssetRegistry know about this asset path (no load).

does_folder_exist.description:
Cheap existence check for a content folder path. True when the AssetRegistry
has the path indexed (it holds at least one asset directly or recursively).
Accepts "/Game/Foo" with or without trailing slash.

find_asset_dependency_cycles.description: Find cycles whose packages are all inside PackagePath.

find_orphan_asset_candidates.description: Candidates only: registry references do not include every config or C++ soft load.

find_redirectors_under_path.description:
Find every UObjectRedirector under a content folder. Pair with
`unreal.UnrealBridgeEditorLibrary.fixup_redirectors` for batch cleanup.

get_asset_class_path.description:
Just the class path of an asset (no tags, no disk size). Cheap lookup when you
only need to know "what kind of asset is this?". Returns "" if the asset is unknown.

get_asset_class_paths_batch.description:
Batch class-path lookup. OutClassPaths is aligned 1:1 with AssetPaths —
unknown assets yield "" at that index. One registry pass, no load. Use instead
of N GetAssetClassPath round-trips.

get_asset_count_under_path.description:
Count assets under a content folder in a single registry sweep. No soft paths
are materialized — cheap way to decide whether a folder is small enough to list.
Optional ClassFilter is a TopLevelAssetPath ("" = any class). Returns 0 on
unknown folder.

get_asset_dependency_tree.description: Bounded, flat dependency tree suitable for one bridge response.

get_asset_disk_sizes_batch.description:
Batch disk size (bytes) for many asset paths. OutSizes is aligned 1:1 with
AssetPaths; unresolved entries are -1. Sidesteps N GetAssetInfo round-trips
when the caller only wants sizes.

get_asset_info.description: Registry-backed asset metadata: class path, redirector flag, disk size, all tags. No load.

get_asset_references.description:
Get all dependencies and referencers of an asset in one call.
Accepts object path or export-text path with quotes.

get_asset_tag_value.description:
Read a single AssetRegistry tag value for an asset. No load. Returns "" when the
asset is unknown or the tag does not exist on it.

get_asset_tag_values_batch.description:
Batch read of a single AssetRegistry tag value for many asset paths, one
registry pass. OutValues is aligned 1:1 with AssetPaths — missing assets or
missing tags produce an empty string at that index.

get_assets_by_class.description:
All assets of a given class. ClassPath is a TopLevelAssetPath string, e.g.
"/Script/Engine.Texture2D" or "/Game/BP/BP_MyActor.BP_MyActor_C".

get_assets_by_package_paths.description:
Batch list every asset under any of the given content folder paths in a single
registry sweep. Optional ClassFilter is a TopLevelAssetPath ("" = all classes).
`bRecursive` controls subfolder descent for the path filter, and also enables
recursive class matching when ClassFilter is non-empty.

get_assets_by_tag_value.description:
All assets whose AssetRegistry tag matches (TagName, TagValue). Optional class filter
narrows the sweep ("" = all classes, accepts TopLevelAssetPath string).

get_assets_of_classes.description:
One registry pass returning every asset whose class matches any entry in
`ClassPaths` (TopLevelAssetPath strings). Use instead of N separate
`GetAssetsByClass` calls when you need multiple types at once.

get_content_roots.description:
List all mounted content roots visible to the AssetRegistry (e.g. "/Game/",
"/Engine/", plugin roots). Trailing slashes match UE's own convention — strip
before passing to registry APIs that expect no trailing slash.

get_data_asset_soft_paths_by_asset_path.description: Same as GetDataAssetsByAssetPath but returns soft paths.

get_data_asset_soft_paths_by_base_class.description: Same as GetDataAssetsByBaseClass but returns soft paths.

get_data_assets_by_asset_path.description: Get all DataAssets by loading the base class from an asset path.

get_data_assets_by_base_class.description: Get all DataAssets of a given base class (recursive).

get_derived_classes.description: Get all classes derived from the given base classes (excluding SKEL_, REINST_, hidden, deprecated).

get_derived_classes_by_blueprint_path.description:
Get all classes derived from a Blueprint (by asset path).
Accepts content path, object path, or export-text path with quotes.

get_package_dependencies.description:
Package-level dependencies. PackageName is a content path like "/Game/BP/BP_MyActor"
(no class-name suffix). When bHardOnly is true, only Hard+Game dependencies are
returned (cooker-relevant); otherwise all categories. Returns package name strings.

get_package_dependencies_recursive.description:
Transitive package dependency closure, bounded by MaxDepth. The returned set
is the union of all packages reachable from PackageName via dependency edges,
excluding PackageName itself. When bHardOnly=true, only Hard+Game edges are
traversed (cooker-relevant closure). MaxDepth <= 0 is treated as unlimited.

get_package_referencers.description:
Package-level referencers. Mirror of GetPackageDependencies. Useful before
rename/delete to check "who would break if this package goes away".

get_skeletal_mesh_info.description:
Per-LOD vertex / triangle counts, mesh bounds, material slots, bone /
socket / morph target counts, bound Skeleton + PhysicsAsset paths for
a USkeletalMesh.

get_sound_info.description:
Duration, sample rate, channel count, loop flag for a USoundWave or
USoundCue. SoundCue duration is the computed total cue length; sample
rate + channel count are only populated for SoundWave.

get_static_mesh_info.description:
Per-LOD vertex / triangle counts, mesh bounds, material slots, sockets,
UV channel count, Nanite flag for a UStaticMesh asset.
Returns `bFound = false` if the asset path can't be resolved.

get_sub_folder_names.description: Get immediate sub-folder names under a content path.

get_sub_folder_paths.description: Get immediate sub-folder paths under a content path.

get_texture_info.description:
Dimensions, pixel format, compression settings, LOD group, sRGB flag,
resident memory bytes for a UTexture2D.

get_total_disk_size_under_path.description:
Aggregate .uasset/.umap disk bytes under a content folder in a single registry
sweep. Optional ClassFilter narrows by TopLevelAssetPath ("" = any class).
Returns total size; OutAssetCount is filled with the number of assets summed.
Unresolvable files are skipped silently.

list_assets_under_path.description: List all asset soft paths under a content folder path.

resolve_redirector.description:
If AssetPath resolves to a UObjectRedirector, follow one hop and return the target
object path as a string. Returns empty string when not a redirector or on failure.

search_assets.description:
SearchEverywhere-style keyword search with full options.
Supports include/exclude tokens ("hero !enemy"), type filter ("&Type=Blueprint").
search_assets.doc: X.search_assets(query, scope, class_filter, case_sensitive, whole_word, max_results, min_characters, custom_package_path) -> (out_soft_paths=Array[SoftObjectPath], out_include_tokens_for_highlight=Array[str])

search_assets_in_all_content.description: Simplified: search all content roots, case-insensitive, no whole-word, MinCharacters=1.

search_assets_under_path.description: Simplified: search under a specific content folder path.

add_async_action_node.description:
Spawn a `K2Node_AsyncAction` wired to a factory function on a
`UBlueprintAsyncActionBase` subclass. Reliable alternative to
`SpawnNodeByActionKey` for async tasks whose action-key signatures
change across sessions.

Typical factory classes:
  - `UAbilityAsync_WaitGameplayEvent` (GAS)
  - `UMoviePlayerAsyncTask`           (media)
  - Any user-defined
    `UBlueprintAsyncActionBase`-derived class.

@param FactoryClassPath     `/Script/<Module>.<ClassName>` or short
                            class name.
@param FactoryFunctionName  Short name of the static factory UFUNCTION
                            on the factory class.
@return GUID of the new node, or "" on failure (bad class / function).
add_async_action_node.doc: X.add_async_action_node(blueprint_path, graph_name, factory_class_path, factory_function_name, node_pos_x, node_pos_y) -> str

add_blueprint_component.description:
Add a new component to an Actor Blueprint's SimpleConstructionScript.
ComponentClassPath: native class path (e.g. "/Script/Engine.StaticMeshComponent")
or Blueprint component class path with trailing _C.
ComponentName: variable name for the new component (must be unique within the BP).
ParentComponentName: optional — attach under this component (empty = attach under root, or become root if none).
Compiles on success.
@return true on success

add_blueprint_interface.description:
Add an interface implementation to a Blueprint. InterfacePath can be a content path
to a Blueprint interface (e.g. "/Game/BPI_Foo") or a native class path
("/Script/MyModule.UMyInterface"). Compiles on success.
@return true on success

add_blueprint_variable.description:
Add a new variable to a Blueprint.
Type string: "Bool", "Int", "Float", "Double", "String", "Name", "Text",
             "Vector", "Rotator", "Transform", "LinearColor",
             or a class/struct name for object/struct references.
             Prefix with "Array of " for arrays (e.g. "Array of Float").

@return true on success

add_branch_node.description: Add a Branch (If-Then-Else) node. Returns node GUID or "" on failure.

add_break_struct_node.description: Insert a BreakStruct node for the given UScriptStruct path.
add_break_struct_node.doc: X.add_break_struct_node(blueprint_path, graph_name, struct_path, x, y) -> str

add_breakpoint.description: Create / toggle a debug breakpoint on a node (by GUID).

add_call_function_node.doc: X.add_call_function_node(blueprint_path, graph_name, target_class_path, function_name, node_pos_x, node_pos_y) -> str

add_cast_node.description: Add a DynamicCast node. `bPure` → no exec pins. `TargetClassPath` can be a native or BP class path.
add_cast_node.doc: X.add_cast_node(blueprint_path, graph_name, target_class_path, pure, node_pos_x, node_pos_y) -> str

add_comment_box.description: Add a comment box wrapping the provided node guids (pass empty to just position). Returns new comment GUID.
add_comment_box.doc: X.add_comment_box(blueprint_path, graph_name, node_guids, text, x, y, width, height) -> str

add_custom_event_node.description: Add a Custom Event node (K2Node_CustomEvent) with the given name.
add_custom_event_node.doc: X.add_custom_event_node(blueprint_path, graph_name, event_name, node_pos_x, node_pos_y) -> str

add_delay_node.description: Insert a Delay latent node (KismetSystemLibrary::Delay) with Duration pin default.
add_delay_node.doc: X.add_delay_node(blueprint_path, graph_name, duration_seconds, x, y) -> str

add_dispatcher_bind_node.description: Add a Bind/Unbind node for a self Event Dispatcher. `bUnbind=true` → unbind.
add_dispatcher_bind_node.doc: X.add_dispatcher_bind_node(blueprint_path, graph_name, dispatcher_name, unbind, node_pos_x, node_pos_y) -> str

add_dispatcher_call_node.description: Add a Call (Broadcast) node for a self Event Dispatcher.

add_dispatcher_event_node.description:
Create a CustomEvent whose signature matches the dispatcher's. Caller still needs
an AddDelegate node + a Self-typed target pin to actually bind it.

add_enhanced_input_action_event_node.description:
Spawn a UK2Node_EnhancedInputAction event node bound to a specific
UInputAction asset. The asset reference is set BEFORE AllocateDefaultPins
so the node ships with its full pin set: 5 exec out pins
(Triggered/Started/Ongoing/Canceled/Completed) + ActionValue (typed by
the IA's ValueType) + ElapsedSeconds + TriggeredSeconds + InputAction.

Reuses an existing node bound to the same IA if one already lives on
the graph (matches UInputActionEventNodeSpawner::FindExistingNode).

The Blueprint must support input events (Pawn/Actor/PlayerController/...)
and the graph must not be a construction script — caller's
responsibility; this function does not preflight.

@return GUID of the new (or reused) node, or "" on failure.

add_enum_literal_node.description:
Insert a Literal Enum node (K2Node_EnumLiteral) for the given UEnum asset/native path.
EnumPath: e.g. "/Script/Engine.EComponentMobility" or a user-defined enum path.
ValueName: the short enum entry name (e.g. "Static"). Leave empty to use the first entry.
add_enum_literal_node.doc: X.add_enum_literal_node(blueprint_path, graph_name, enum_path, value_name, node_pos_x, node_pos_y) -> str

add_event_dispatcher.description: Add a new Event Dispatcher (multicast delegate) with no parameters.

add_event_node.doc: X.add_event_node(blueprint_path, graph_name, parent_class_path, event_name, node_pos_x, node_pos_y) -> str

add_for_loop_node.description: Insert a ForLoop (or ForLoopWithBreak if bWithBreak) macro node.
add_for_loop_node.doc: X.add_for_loop_node(blueprint_path, graph_name, with_break, x, y) -> str

add_foreach_node.description: Insert a ForEachLoop (or ForEachLoopWithBreak if bWithBreak) macro node.
add_foreach_node.doc: X.add_foreach_node(blueprint_path, graph_name, with_break, x, y) -> str

add_function_local_variable.description:
Add a local variable to a function graph. Same TypeString grammar as
AddBlueprintVariable ("Bool" / "Int" / "Float" / "Vector" / class paths /
"Array of X" prefix). Compiles on success so the variable becomes visible
to subsequent variable-get/set node spawns.

@return true if the variable was added; false if the function graph is
        missing, the name is taken, or the TypeString couldn't be parsed.

add_function_local_variable_node.description:
Add a variable-get / variable-set node for a function-scope local
variable. Equivalent to AddVariableNode but resolves against the
function's LocalVariables instead of BP->NewVariables — AddVariableNode
can't spawn local-var nodes because the VariableReference has to carry
the function scope, not the self-member scope.

@return GUID of the new node, or "" if the variable is missing / the
        graph isn't a function graph.
add_function_local_variable_node.doc: X.add_function_local_variable_node(blueprint_path, function_name, variable_name, is_set, node_pos_x, node_pos_y) -> str

add_function_parameter.description:
Add a parameter to a function graph.
`bIsReturn=false` → input pin on FunctionEntry. `bIsReturn=true` → output pin on FunctionResult
(result node auto-created if absent). TypeString uses the same format as AddBlueprintVariable.
add_function_parameter.doc: X.add_function_parameter(blueprint_path, function_name, param_name, type_string, is_return) -> bool

add_get_input_action_value_node.description:
Spawn a UK2Node_GetInputActionValue (a pure "Get Input Action Value"
node — not the event node). Output value pin is typed by the IA's
ValueType: Boolean → bool, Axis1D → double, Axis2D → Vector2D,
Axis3D → Vector. Use this when you need the IA's current value
inside a non-event graph (functions, custom events, etc.) instead
of routing through the EnhancedInputAction event node.

@return GUID of the new node, or "" on failure.

add_input_axis_key_event_node.description: Spawn a UK2Node_InputAxisKeyEvent for a raw axis FKey (e.g. "Mouse X").

add_input_key_event_node.description: Spawn a UK2Node_InputKey for a raw FKey (e.g. "SpaceBar").

add_interface_message_node.doc: X.add_interface_message_node(blueprint_path, graph_name, interface_path, function_name, node_pos_x, node_pos_y) -> str
